invariant: Every model-owned assumption family binds to a versioned registry entry {policy_id, version, owned_assumption, evidence_hierarchy}; case-level policy objects carry the binding and a version change is receipt-visible on the sealed case.

owned_assumption.description: Which facility (if any) balances liquidity, its committed capacity, opening draw and commitment-fee convention.

rcf_policy.notes: Stamped at the compilePolicies attach seam (scripts/lib/case_compiler.mjs). mode:none carries explicit zero capacity/draw/fee authority — never a silent default.

owned_assumption.description: Opening/historical cash authority, minimum-cash floor, eligible-cash percentage, cash yield and interest-income cash-flow classification (or explicit bucket authority).

cash_policy.notes: Question-round answers (flow_questions.mjs) mutate cash_policy fields after compile; they add fields and never remove the stamped binding.

owned_assumption.description: Lease modelling mode, historical/opening liability authority, roll-forward drivers, interest basis and gross/net-debt/leverage inclusion.

lease_policy.notes: interest_basis defaulting to total_liability for IFRS issuers (lease_policy.mjs:13-23) is part of this family; declared-vs-defaulted receipt parity is proof C follow-on.

owned_assumption.description: Effective-tax-rate completion below guidance/broker/user authorities: median or latest usable normalized historical ETR, explicit loss-case treatment.

tax_rate_policy.notes: The generalisation prototype: already carries schema_version and a sealed case receipt. Registry binding of that receipt is follow-on.

owned_assumption.description: Acquisition overlay: consideration, funding mix, close-period conventions and post-close roll-in treatment.

acquisition_policy.notes: Case `acquisition` object is versionless and has FOUR post-compile in-place writers (build_dynamic_model.mjs:12335, release_nodes.mjs:136, public_test_run.mjs:242, evidence_run.mjs:692) — binding requires forbidden files; follow-on.

owned_assumption.description: The open bag of ~10 driver policies (revenue growth, margins, capex, working capital, dividends, FX drivers) read by the solver without a declared vocabulary.

forecast_assumptions.notes: Binding requires solver.mjs (forbidden) and a driver vocabulary; each driver family may split into its own entry when bound.

owned_assumption.description: Disclosure-coverage treatment: which filed lines must be individually represented versus lawfully aggregated.

coverage_policy.notes: coverage.mjs is forbidden this package; binding is follow-on.

owned_assumption.description: Which reported interest basis anchors the historical interest reconciliation.

historical_interest_basis.notes: reported_interest_basis silently defaults to LEGACY_BASIS (filed_total_including_leases); versioning that default is the point of binding this family.

owned_assumption.description: The residual tolerance under which an opening-debt reconciliation is accepted.

debt_reconciliation_residual_tolerance.notes: The literal 0.05 is hardcoded in THREE places; binding must first centralise it (all three owners are outside this package's allowed files).

owned_assumption.description: The convention translating native-currency instrument balances and flows into the reporting currency.

fx_translation.notes: Minted inside case_compiler outside the compilePolicies allowed region; binding is follow-on.

owned_assumption.description: How unexplained residual interest between filed totals and instrument-level interest is attributed.
Per-metric materiality thresholds gating flow-impact findings.
Which broker headline metrics anchor consensus selection and how conflicts resolve.
The canonical debt-class vocabulary and legacy-alias migration rules for instrument classification.
Circularity controls, solver tolerances and workbook iterative-calculation numerics.
Stage runtime budgets and cancellation treatment; owns no model-graph assumption.
